abilities.name: Undying
abilities.description: Leoric becomes a ghost when he dies, and resurrects upon reaching full Health. Leoric deals no damage while dead. Wrath Of The Bone King Leoric's first two Basic Attacks cleave for 100% damage, and his third Basic Attack deals 225% damage to a single target.; trait

fields.notes: Damage bonus of the third attack (+125%) stacks additively with other offensive damage modifiers that can affect Leoric's Basic Attack damage.

abilities.name: Skeletal Swing
abilities.description: Leoric swings his mace, dealing 150 damage and Slowing enemies by 40% for 2.5 seconds. If an enemy Hero is hit, refund 50% of the cooldown and Mana cost. Deals 75% additional damage to Minions. Peasants!

fields.notes: Damage bonus to Minions stacks additively with other offensive damage modifiers that can affect Skeletal Swing 's damage.
Replaces Skeletal Swing while Undying. Does not benefit from talents affecting Skeletal Swing.

abilities.name: Drain Hope
abilities.description: Grab an enemy Hero's soul, dealing up to 20% of their maximum Health as damage and healing Leoric for up to 20% of his maximum Health while he is nearby, over 4 seconds. Leoric's Movement Speed is reduced by 20% while this is active.

fields.notes: Drain Hope is interrupted if Leoric dies or is put in Stasis.

abilities.name: Drain Essence
abilities.description: Throw out a chain, attaching to the first enemy Hero hit, healing Leoric for up to 10% of his maximum Health over 4 seconds as long as the enemy remains close.

fields.notes: Replaces Drain Hope while Undying. Does not benefit from Talents affecting Drain Hope. Drain Essence applied to a target before they change states may remain on them in some cases (e.g. D.Va before she uses Self-Destruct).

abilities.name: Wraith Walk
abilities.description: Leoric separates from his body, becoming Unstoppable and gaining Movement Speed accelerating up to 50% over 2.5 seconds. When Wraith Walk ends or is canceled, his body jumps to his wraith.; 14 / 0.25

fields.notes: Can be cast while Rooted. Wraith Walk can be reactivated after 0.25 seconds to apply its end effect early. Leoric's Wraith is an Invulnerable Summon that has regular base Movement Speed. Wraith's Movement Speed can be affected by conveyor belts in Volskaya Foundry. Leoric can pass through pathing blockers and enemy Gates while Wraith Walking, but not through real terrain. Unstoppable is removed before teleporting to Wraith. Wraith Walk is interrupted, without teleporting Leoric, if he dies or is put in Stasis.

abilities.name: Entomb
abilities.description: Create an unpassable tomb for 4 seconds.; 50; 90; heroic

fields.notes: Entomb can be reactivated after 0.5 seconds to end its effect early.

abilities.name: March of the Black King
abilities.description: Leoric becomes Unstoppable and walks forward, swinging his mace 3 times. Enemies hit take 250 damage, and Heroes hit heal Leoric for 12% of his maximum Health.; 50; 75; heroic

fields.type: Spell Damage / Healing, Movement: Dash, Status effect
fields.notes: First swing takes place 0.5 seconds after the cast and the following two at 1 second intervals. Cannot be cast while Rooted.

talents.name: Consume Vitality
talents.description: Skeletal Swing's cooldown is reduced by 2 seconds. Enemy Heroes hit heal Leoric for 4% of his maximum Health.

fields.notes: Baseline cooldown reduction from hitting a Hero is applied after base reduction from Consume Vitality.

_raw_fields: Skeletal Swing's cooldown is reduced by 2 seconds. Enemy Heroes hit heal Leoric for 4% of his maximum Health.

talents.name: Fealty Unto Death
talents.description: When a nearby friendly or enemy Minion dies, Leoric restores 1.25% of his maximum Health and 6 Mana.
_raw_fields: When a nearby friendly or enemy Minion dies, Leoric restores 1.25% of his maximum Health and 6 Mana.

talents.name: Ossein Renewal
talents.description: Cooldown 120 Active Activate to heal Leoric for 30% of his maximum Health over 5 seconds. Regeneration Globes lower the cooldown of this Ability by 20 seconds.
_raw_fields: Cooldown 120 Active Activate to heal Leoric for 30% of his maximum Health over 5 seconds. Regeneration Globes lower the cooldown of this Ability by 20 seconds.

talents.description: Increase the range of Skeletal Swing by 25%.
_raw_fields: Increase the range of Skeletal Swing by 25%.

talents.name: Paralyzing Rage
talents.description: Increase the Slow of Skeletal Swing by 20%.
_raw_fields: Increase the Slow of Skeletal Swing by 20%.

talents.name: Kneel, Peasants!
talents.description: Skeletal Swing deals 75% additional damage to Mercenaries and Monsters, and hitting them activates Skeletal Swing's cost and cooldown refund.

fields.notes: Damage bonus stacks additively with other offensive damage modifiers that can affect Skeletal Swing 's damage.

_raw_fields: Skeletal Swing deals 75% additional damage to Mercenaries and Monsters, and hitting them activates Skeletal Swing's cost and cooldown refund.

talents.name: Willing Vessel
talents.description: Increase the healing from Drain Hope to 25% of Leoric's maximum Health. If Drain Hope lasts its full duration, Leoric instantly heals for an additional 5% of his maximum Health.
_raw_fields: Increase the healing from Drain Hope to 25% of Leoric's maximum Health. If Drain Hope lasts its full duration, Leoric instantly heals for an additional 5% of his maximum Health.

talents.name: Drain Momentum
talents.description: Drain Hope no longer reduces Leoric's Movement Speed. If Drain Hope lasts its full duration, gain 30% Movement Speed for 4 seconds.
_raw_fields: Drain Hope no longer reduces Leoric's Movement Speed. If Drain Hope lasts its full duration, gain 30% Movement Speed for 4 seconds.

talents.description: Increase Wraith Walk's duration by 100%. Enemy Heroes that come in contact with the wraith deal 50% less damage for 4 seconds.

fields.notes: Damage reduction stacks additively with other offensive damage modifiers affecting the target Hero's damage output.

talents.name: Spectral Leech
talents.description: Basic Attacks against enemy Heroes deal bonus damage equal to 2.5% of the Hero's maximum Health and heal Leoric for twice that amount.

fields.notes: Only affects the primary target of the Basic Attack. Only heals for twice the bonus damage actually dealt (relevant if the target has less than 2.5% of maximum Health remaining).

_raw_fields: Basic Attacks against enemy Heroes deal bonus damage equal to 2.5% of the Hero's maximum Health and heal Leoric for twice that amount.

talents.name: Crushing Hope
talents.description: If Drain Hope lasts its full duration, it instantly deals an additional 15% of the target's maximum Health as damage. This damage does not heal Leoric.
_raw_fields: If Drain Hope lasts its full duration, it instantly deals an additional 15% of the target's maximum Health as damage. This damage does not heal Leoric.

talents.name: Royal Focus
talents.description: Wraith Walk increases the damage of the next Skeletal Swing within 5 seconds by 50%. Each enemy Hero hit by this Skeletal Swing reduces the cooldown of Wraith Walk by 7 seconds.

fields.notes: Stacks additively with other offensive damage modifiers affecting Skeletal Swing 's damage.

talents.name: Mithril Mace
talents.description: Increase Leoric's Attack Speed by 20%. Repeatable Quest Nearby enemy Minion deaths grant 0.3% permanent Attack Speed, and Takedowns grant 3% permanent Attack Speed, up to 30%.
_raw_fields: Increase Leoric's Attack Speed by 20%. Repeatable Quest Nearby enemy Minion deaths grant 0.3% permanent Attack Speed, and Takedowns grant 3% permanent Attack Speed, up to 30%.

talents.name: Buried Alive
talents.description: The duration of Entomb is lowered by 1 second, but enemies trapped inside are Silenced and take 50 damage every 1 second.

fields.notes: Because of the relatively low tickrate, it is possible for e.g. Lúcio to High Five in and Cleanse targets, without it being canceled by being Silenced on the way in, if timed correctly.

_raw_fields: The duration of Entomb is lowered by 1 second, but enemies trapped inside are Silenced and take 50 damage every 1 second.

talents.name: Death March
talents.description: The final swing of March of the Black King also applies Drain Hope to nearby enemy Heroes.

fields.notes: 1) Extended by Leoric's unit radius. Movement speed bonuses from multiple instances of Drain Momentum do not stack. Hopelessness does not affect the initial radius of Death March application. Only the active range is increased. Death March fully interacts with all other Talents affecting Drain Hope. Drain Hopes applied to a target before they change states may remain on them in some cases (e.g. D.Va before she uses Self-Destruct).

_raw_fields: The final swing of March of the Black King also applies Drain Hope to nearby enemy Heroes.

talents.name: Burning Despair
talents.description: Deal 40 damage per second to nearby enemies. While Drain Hope is active, gain 40 Armor and the damage and area is increased by 100%.

fields.notes: Damage from Burning Despair is unaffected by external offensive damage modifiers, doesn't trigger lifesteal effects and doesn't draw tower aggro from A Call For Help. Does not stack with other positive Armor effects. Other defensive damage modifiers may stack.

_raw_fields: Deal 40 damage per second to nearby enemies. While Drain Hope is active, gain 40 Armor and the damage and area is increased by 100%.

talents.name: Shroud of the Dead King
talents.description: Cooldown 25 Active Activate to become Protected for 3 seconds, preventing all damage.
